native.method: decoded-frame inspection plus passthrough RGB scan of every decoded frame at 320x180, panel band x 90-230 y 4-55
native.note: Host panel is the measurement. Attempts 1-3 are not onset. Restore of ABSENT is cleanup, not prevention. netsh result 0 is not a named API denial.

finshield.method: panel crop 1120,20,1600,700 scaled to 80x35 plus full-frame minus taskbar and 320x180 panel band
finshield.note: Panel stayed white ABSENT. netsh command-was-not-found text is not the desktop measurement.
